subject.title: fix(agents): close symlink-then-.. workspace boundary bypass in assertSandboxPath

question: Should this hardening merge as POSIX-only after an explicit determination that supported Windows paths are unaffected, or should the raw-resolution invariant be made cross-platform before merge?
rationale: The branch deliberately leaves one supported platform on the prior lexical-only validation path; that is a security-boundary scope choice rather than a mechanical review detail.

options.title: Prove Windows is unaffected
options.body: Document and test why supported Windows paths cannot produce this symlink/reparse-point plus `..` boundary mismatch, then merge the focused POSIX fix.

options.title: Make the invariant cross-platform
options.body: Extend the raw-resolution protection and regression coverage to every supported platform where the operating system can resolve an uncollapsed path differently from lexical normalization.

options.title: Pause for security-owner direction
options.body: Hold the PR until a sandbox-boundary owner chooses the intended supported-platform contract.

recommendation.title: Make the invariant cross-platform
recommendation.body: Extend the raw-resolution protection and regression coverage to every supported platform where the operating system can resolve an uncollapsed path differently from lexical normalization.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available adjacent owner for the repository’s filesystem sandbox and threat-model boundary.
